messages:
violet: Quick sync: platform wants to converge routing headers into one canonical header (`Rd-Route`) and retire `X-Rd-Route` in SDKs. Need SDK owners + console folks to agree on telemetry fields and rollout UX.
max: Sounds fine. Biggest risk is quota attribution jumps when console stops reading legacy header. We need server fallback + a console backfill plan.
toni: Agreed. Propose these telemetry fields: `route_header_version`, `route_header_client` (values: `py`, `ts`, `go`, `server`), and `route_header_seen` (bool). Keeps dashboards deterministic.
sam: For SDKs: opt-in flag first, one minor with deprecation log + telemetry event, then removal after grace period. I'll prepare code helpers for Python/TS/Go. Snippet for py:
```
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, route_header_mode="v2_opt_in")
```
max: Can we add a small server-side shim that maps legacy header -> v2 and emits a `route_header_translation` event so console can reconcile? That would help CS metrics.
violet: Yes, platform agreed to emit translation events for 90 days. Console: please surface % translated traffic per tenant.
toni: Will add new tile: "Routing header migration" with %legacy / %translated / %native. Also add a tiny migration checklist for CS.
sam: I'll open PRs today: py + ts examples now, go helper later today. Plan to include tolerant parsing + a deprecation metric so we can nudge customers.
max: devex-bot: canary run showed flaky header parsing for py when header empty (py-canary#212). Filed ticket.
violet: Timeline proposal: announce today, opt-in SDK patch in 1 week, telemetry tile + sampling enabled in 2 weeks, server dry-run at 5 weeks, hard remove at 12 weeks. Anyone blocked?
toni: Console ETA 10 days (tile + backfill job). Might need an extra day for privacy review on per-tenant metrics.
sam: SDK PRs: py/ts by EOD, go PR tomorrow. Will add release notes & migration snippet.
max: ACK. I'll coordinate canaries and CS outreach after tile exists.
violet: Great. pls reply with ack + ETA. devex-bot: reminder set for 3 days to check PR status and canary results.
